name: restraunt_pos
description: Restaurant POS and website ordering system

paragraphs: Restaurant ordering, POS and growth platform. Every restaurant gets its own ordering website and an admin dashboard for the menu, orders, POS, kitchen, tables, delivery, offers, loyalty, WhatsApp and marketing, plus apps for waiters, chefs, managers and riders. Many restaurants run on one installation; a superadmin manages them.
Live: restrogrow.com · User guide: restrogrow.com/main/views/user-guide.html · WhatsApp partner: repeatgrow.com
features: Mobile-first ordering site per restaurant at restrogrow.com/{slug} or the restaurant's own domain
Home page with banners, categories, Today's Specials, Bestsellers and the full menu; many layouts (layout gallery)
Dish details with sizes, add-ons, notes, ingredients, nutrition and health tags
Cart with milestone offers, coupons, Complete your meal suggestions and a clear bill
Dine-in, takeaway and delivery (pincode or per-km), scheduled orders, map pin for the address

requirements.text: POS and KOT (kitchen tickets), with network or browser printing; customers on the bill with points, rewards and wallet, and an Account QR for website login
Waiter, chef and manager dashboards with their own logins and push notifications; rider page (no login) with route and live location
